description: Memory tools test case 1. Tests that agents can retrieve information from memory and inbox emails to perform complex email tasks. Session 1: 5 memory setup queries. Session 2: 5 emails inserted into inbox. Session 3: 5 reply/forward/send email queries requiring both memory and email information.

steps.user_message: For context, here's my health info for today: I took my blood pressure medication at 8 AM and 8 PM, and my readings were 120/80 in the morning and 118/78 in the evening. My daily log ID for today is HL-8842.
steps.expected_behavior: Agent should acknowledge or note the health information: medication at 8 AM and 8 PM, readings 120/80 and 118/78, daily log ID HL-8842.
steps.agent_response:
Thanks — got it. I’ve recorded:

- Daily log ID: HL-8842
- Medication times: 8:00 AM, 8:00 PM
- Readings: 120/80 (morning), 118/78 (evening)
- Date: today (2026-02-22)

What would you like me to do with this info? Here are quick options (I can draft or send any of these):

1) Email to your doctor
   - Subject: Daily BP update — HL-8842 (2026-02-22)
   - Body: 
     Hello Dr. [Last name],
     
     Today’s blood pressure record (Daily log ID HL-8842):
     - Medication taken at 8:00 AM and 8:00 PM
     - Morning reading: 120/80
     - Evening reading: 118/78
     
     No new symptoms to report. Please let me know if you recommend any changes.
     
     Thank you,
     [Your name]

2) Update/caregiver note
   - Subject: Quick health update — HL-8842
   - Body:
     Hi,
     
     Quick update for today (HL-8842): meds at 8 AM & 8 PM; BP 120/80 (AM), 118/78 (PM). All stable.
     
     —[Your name]

3) Save to your records (draft)
   - Subject: Health Log HL-8842 — 2026-02-22
   - Body: concise log with times, meds, readings (I can save as a draft email to yourself or create a note).

Tell me which action you want and provide any missing details:
- Which template (Doctor / Caregiver / Draft)?
- Recipient email address (if sending)
- Doctor’s or recipient’s name to personalize the message
- Any additional notes or symptoms to include

I’ll draft or send it as you choose.

steps.description: Insert email into inbox containing: Hello, please share your medication schedule and blood pressure readings for today. I need the times you took your medication and both readings.
Start new session to test reply/forward/send email with memory and email information

steps.user_message: Reply to the email from Dr. Patricia Brown (subject: 'Daily Health Log Request') and include the medication and health information I shared with you that you have saved in memory.
steps.expected_behavior: Agent should reply to an email from Dr. Patricia Brown (patricia.brown@clinic.com) containing the information: I took my blood pressure medication at 8 AM and 8 PM today, and my readings were 120/80 in the morning and 118/78 in the evening. My daily log ID for today is HL-8842.
steps.agent_response:
I can send that reply — but I don’t have any medication or health details stored in my memory from you. Do you want me to:

1) Include the medication and health info you paste here now (I’ll send immediately),  
2) Search your inbox for an earlier message where you shared those details and include what I find, or  
3) Send a short reply to Dr. Brown asking for clarification/time to gather the log?

If you choose 1, paste the medication list and any health notes (allergies, vitals, symptoms, dates/times, or anything specific you want included).  
If you choose 2, I’ll search for terms like “medication,” “health log,” or “daily health” and include the most relevant info I find.

Example draft I would send once I have the details (I will customize with your actual info):

Hi Dr. Brown,

Thanks — attached below is my daily health log.

Medications:
- [medication name, dose, frequency]
- [medication name, dose, frequency]

Health information / notes:
- Allergies: [if any]
- Vitals / readings: [e.g., blood pressure, glucose, weight, dates/times]
- Symptoms / notes: [brief summary]

Please let me know if you need anything else or a different format.

Thanks,  
[Your Name]

Which option would you like?

validators.extract_focus: medication times (8 AM and 8 PM), blood pressure readings (120/80 morning, 118/78 evening), and daily log ID HL-8842
validators.comparison_query: Verify that the email body contains the medication and health information: medication taken at 8 AM and 8 PM (or equivalent phrasing such as 8:00 AM), blood pressure readings 120/80 and 118/78, and daily log ID HL-8842. Allow equivalent phrasings for times and numbers.
